title: Count Asterisks
statement: Count the asterisks that are not inside any pair of '|' characters.
explanation: Toggle an outside/inside state at each bar and count '*' only while outside.

title: Check if Matrix Is X-Matrix
statement: Return true if both diagonals contain only nonzero values and all other cells are zero.
explanation: For each cell, test whether it lies on either diagonal and enforce the corresponding zero/nonzero condition.

title: Decode the Message
statement: Decode message using the first-occurrence order of letters in key, preserving spaces.
explanation: Assign a-z to distinct non-space key letters in order, then translate each message character.
example: key="the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", message="vkbs bs t suepuv" -> "this is a secret"

title: Evaluate Boolean Binary Tree
statement: Evaluate a binary tree whose leaves are 0/1 and whose internal nodes represent OR (2) or AND (3).
explanation: Return leaf truth values directly; recursively evaluate children and apply the node's boolean operator.

title: Minimum Amount of Time to Fill Cups
approach: Maximum of largest pile and half the total
statement: Return the minimum seconds needed to fill all cups, filling two different types per second when possible.
explanation: The answer is bounded by the largest amount and by the ceiling of half the total amount; the maximum is optimal.

title: Maximum Number of Pairs in Array
statement: Return the number of equal-value pairs and the number of leftover elements.
explanation: Each frequency contributes floor(frequency/2) pairs; leftovers equal n minus twice the pair count.

title: Best Poker Hand
statement: Classify a five-card hand as Flush, Three of a Kind, Pair, or High Card.
explanation: Flush has priority; otherwise rank frequency determines the strongest remaining category.

title: First Letter to Appear Twice
statement: Return the first character whose second occurrence is encountered while scanning left to right.
explanation: Maintain a set of seen characters and return immediately when a character is already present.

title: Make Array Zero by Subtracting Equal Amounts
statement: Return the minimum number of operations required to make every array element zero.
explanation: Each operation removes one distinct positive value level, so count the distinct positive elements.

title: Merge Similar Items
approach: Aggregate weights by value in sorted map
statement: Merge weights for matching item values and return value-weight pairs sorted by value.
explanation: Sum weights in a map keyed by value, then emit entries in ascending key order.
